insights.summary: Dynamic number insertion stops swapping numbers after client-side route changes on single-page apps.
insights.quote: since we relaunched the order flow as a single-page app back in september, dynamic number insertion basically stops swapping after a client-side route change. like you land on /order, you click through a couple steps, url changes but no full reload, and the number in the header just... stays whatever loaded first. mobile click-to-call is the worst, people tapping the button get our default 800 number instead of the campaign one.
